title: 用Bash检测路径所在文件系统使用率并区分采集失败
answer:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
if (( $# != 2 )); then printf 'usage: %s PATH THRESHOLD\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2; fi
path=$1; threshold=$2
if [[ ! $threshold =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]] || (( 10#$threshold < 1 || 10#$threshold > 100 )); then printf 'invalid threshold\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
threshold=$((10#$threshold))
if [[ ! -e "$path" ]]; then printf 'path does not exist: %s\n' "$path" >&2; exit 2; fi
if ! report=$(LC_ALL=C df --output=pcent -- "$path"); then printf 'df failed: %s\n' "$path" >&2; exit 2; fi
line=${report##*$'\n'}
if [[ ! $line =~ ^[[:space:]]*([0-9]+)%[[:space:]]*$ ]]; then printf 'unexpected df output\n' >&2; exit 2; fi
pct=$((10#${BASH_REMATCH[1]}))
if (( pct >= threshold )); then printf 'ALERT path=%s used=%s%%\n' "$path" "$pct"; exit 1; fi
printf 'OK path=%s used=%s%%\n' "$path" "$pct"; exit 0
```

原题知识说明：
以下面向Linux、Bash和GNU df，只打印结果并用退出码表示状态：0正常、1达到阈值、2采集或输入错误。路径明确标识监控对象，不硬编码网卡IP；生产告警系统再接收结果。代码作为题库示例，未执行。

body:
## 操作任务
交付Bash脚本task.sh PATH THRESHOLD，使用GNU df读取指定路径所在文件系统使用率；低于阈值输出OK并退出0，达到或超过阈值输出ALERT并退出1，路径/阈值无效、df失败或输出格式异常时输出错误并退出2。所有路径引用必须保留空格，采集失败不能伪装成0%。

## 提交产物
task.sh

## 验收方法
在隔离Linux子进程中注入低于/等于/高于阈值、df失败、坏输出、路径空格、不存在路径及非法阈值，并检查退出码。

## 能力边界
面向Linux Bash与GNU df；测试使用假的df确定性注入阈值和失败格式，不改动真实文件系统。真实监控还需另行确认预期挂载身份，路径仍存在不等于原挂载仍在。

import sys,pathlib,tempfile,os,subprocess
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True);print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: Bash df threshold checker',flush=True)
if 'NotImplementedError' in pathlib.Path('task.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'):raise NotImplementedError('implement task.sh')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='fake-df-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);bindir=root/'bin';bindir.mkdir();script=root/'task.sh';script.write_text(pathlib.Path('task.sh').read_text(encoding='utf8'),encoding='utf8')
 fake=bindir/'df';fake.write_text("#!/bin/sh\nfor last do :; done\nprintf '%s' \"$last\" > \"$FAKE_DF_ARG\"\ncase \"$FAKE_DF_MODE\" in low) printf 'Use%%\\n89%%\\n';; edge) printf 'Use%%\\n90%%\\n';; high) printf 'Use%%\\n100%%\\n';; bad) printf 'Use%%\\nunknown\\n';; fail) exit 7;; esac\n",encoding='utf8');fake.chmod(0o755)
 target=root/'mount with space';target.write_text('fixture',encoding='utf8');argfile=root/'arg.txt'
 base=os.environ.copy();base['PATH']=str(bindir)+os.pathsep+base.get('PATH','');base['FAKE_DF_ARG']=str(argfile)
 def run(mode,*args):
  env=base.copy();env['FAKE_DF_MODE']=mode;return subprocess.run(['/bin/bash',str(script),*args],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=3)
 low=run('low',str(target),'90');assert low.returncode==0 and 'OK ' in low.stdout and argfile.read_text()==str(target)
 edge=run('edge',str(target),'90');assert edge.returncode==1 and 'ALERT ' in edge.stdout and '90%' in edge.stdout
 high=run('high',str(target),'90');assert high.returncode==1 and '100%' in high.stdout
 for mode in ('bad','fail'):
  result=run(mode,str(target),'90');assert result.returncode==2 and result.stderr
 missing=run('low',str(root/'missing'),'90');assert missing.returncode==2
 for threshold in ('0','101','abc'):
  result=run('low',str(target),threshold);assert result.returncode==2
 result=run('low',str(target));assert result.returncode==2
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
